reponse: The most recent update puts the Q1 2027 payout fee at 0.45%, not the 0.40% in the v3 proposal [2]. That Slack message says the v3 deck is outdated and that volume tiers are unchanged [2]. Earlier documents, including the v3 deck, a Gong call, and a draft customer notice, all cite 0.40% [1][3][4]. A Slack note also says Pinecrest was told 0.40% and that this will be corrected [2]. Customer notices are due by December 1 [2].
